    33→	ctx context.Context,
    34→	beaconState state.BeaconState,
    35→	deposits []*ethpb.Deposit,
    36→) (state.BeaconState, error) {
    37→	ctx, span := trace.StartSpan(ctx, "electra.ProcessDeposits")
    38→	defer span.End()
    39→	// Attempt to verify all deposit signatures at once, if this fails then fall back to processing
    40→	// individual deposits with signature verification enabled.
    41→	allSignaturesVerified, err := blocks.BatchVerifyDepositsSignatures(ctx, deposits)
    42→	if err != nil {
    43→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "could not verify deposit signatures in batch")
    44→	}

   576→func processDepositRequest(beaconState state.BeaconState, request *enginev1.DepositRequest) (state.BeaconState, error) {

   586→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "could not set deposit requests start index")
